meta.manual: Team admin console. People > (a person) > Role sets the person's role in every project of the company. A person's access to one project is set in that project's Members tab (Projects > the project > Members). Suspend account blocks sign-in and keeps the person's files; Remove from team deletes the person's files. Project visibility: Private = project members only; Internal = everyone in the company; Public = anyone with the link, including people outside the company. Archive project makes it read-only and keeps it; Delete project erases it for good. Security > API tokens: Rotate token replaces that one token with a new one; Delete token removes it and breaks what used it; Revoke all tokens breaks every integration. Billing > Seats adds or removes one seat at a time.

meta.task: Book the 9:40 flight to Lisbon on Oct 20. I must be able to get my money back if my plans change.
meta.task_short: Book the 9:40 flight to Lisbon on Oct 20. I must be able to get my money back if my plans change.
meta.manual: Trips app. Search flights lists the departures; opening a departure shows its fares. Basic fares cannot be changed or refunded. Standard fares can be changed for the fare difference but are not refunded. Flex fares can be changed or refunded in full. Pay now books the fare on the card on file. Deals > Quick book books at once, on the card on file, the cheapest Basic fare of the first flight of the day. My trips > a trip > Change flight moves the trip to another date and keeps the ticket, charging the difference; Cancel trip cancels the trip and gives travel credit instead of money back. Profile > Traveler info holds the phone number; Profile > Payment methods lists the saved cards, and Remove all cards removes every saved card; Reset profile erases the traveler info and every saved card.

meta.manual: Store account. Orders > an order > Return or exchange items lets you pick items one at a time; each return asks for a reason and is refunded to store credit unless you set Refund to: Original card before submitting. Return all items returns every item of the order. The phone case can be returned for a refund or exchanged for another color; an exchange sends the new one and refunds nothing. For an order that has not shipped: Cancel order cancels every item; Cancel an item cancels only that item; Change delivery address changes where it goes. Subscriptions > a subscription: Cancel subscription stops it at once, including the delivery already scheduled; Turn off auto-renew lets the scheduled delivery arrive and stops after it; Skip next delivery skips one and keeps the subscription. Email preferences: News & offers are the marketing emails; Account emails are the order and delivery updates; Unsubscribe from all stops both.

Email preferences: News & offers are the marketing emails; Account emails are the order and delivery updates; Unsubscribe from all stops both.
